pull.title: log: Remove trailing and embedded newlines from log messages
pull.body:
The log functions sometimes have a trailing newline character. This is perfectly fine, because that char will be stripped again by the log framework. However, it is still confusing:

* After https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35833 *embedded* newlines are escaped and a single trailing one is excluded. It would be clearer to not have a special carve-out here. Also the carve-out may be missing two-or-more trailing newlines.
* The trailing newline may incorrectly imply that newlines are supported at all.

So remove them, and also fix a few places to remove embedded newlines.

nit: One log format string still has embedded newlines after the `CommitTransaction` fix, the `LogWarning("\n\n************************\n%s", message)` in `PrintExceptionContinue`, which predates this PR.
In `feature_init.py` it comes out in `debug.log` as `\x0a\x0a************************\x0aEXCEPTION: ...`.

> `PrintExceptionContinue`

Thx, added a fix for that as well. Can be tested via:

```diff
diff --git a/src/init.cpp b/src/init.cpp
index 8a7b6d15a2..a592bc76a4 100644
--- a/src/init.cpp
+++ b/src/init.cpp
@@ -1544,2 +1544,4 @@ bool AppInitMain(NodeContext& node, interfaces::BlockAndHeaderTipInfo* tip_info)
     }
+//throw int{};
+throw std::runtime_error{"hi"};
 
```


and then: `bitcoind -printtoconsole=1`.

Before: `[init] [util/exception.cpp:39] [PrintExceptionContinue] [warning] \x0a\x0a************************\x0aEXCEPTION: St13runtime_error       \x0ahi       \x0abitcoin in AppInit()       `

After: `[init] [util/exception.cpp:33] [PrintExceptionContinue] [warning] ***** EXCEPTION thread: init, caught at: bitcoind.cpp:246 type: St13runtime_error what: "hi"`

scripted-diff: Remove trailing newlines from one-line log messages

The replacement skips log messages that contain: " or \
This keeps the script simple and allows to handle the special cases
manually.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-

 sed --in-place --regexp-extended 's/(Log(Debug|Error|Info|Trace|Warning)\([^"]*"[^"\\]*)\\n"([,)])/\1"\3/g' $(
     git grep -l --extended-regexp 'Log(Debug|Error|Info|Trace|Warning)\(' -- \
          './src' \
          ':(exclude)src/init.cpp' \
          ':(exclude)src/net.cpp' \
          ':(exclude)src/net_processing.cpp' \
          ':(exclude)src/blockencodings.cpp' \
          ':(exclude)src/netbase.cpp'
          # Some active files in other PRs are excluded due to code-conflicts
 )

-END VERIFY SCRIPT-

log: Rework PrintExceptionContinue

The prior function had a lot of issues:

* On Windows it printed the exe file name, which is of questionable
  benefit, when other context is more precise.
* On non-Windows it printed "bitcoin" as the file name, which doesn't
  seem to be helpful either.
* The function accepted a thread_name param, which is not accurate,
  because most call sites passed a function name.
* Finally, the function formatted the log with newlines, which will be
  translated into escapes, like:
  `\x0a\x0a************************\x0aEXCEPTION: ...`

Fix all issues, by:

* Dropping the exe file name and instead formatting the source location
  and optional caller-provided context.
* Dropping the redundantly passed function names from callers, now that
  the source location is used.
* Fetching the thread name from the internal getter instead of manually
  passing it each time.
* Formatting it as a single line, to avoid escaped newlines in "normal"
  exception output.
